title: MyLinden Help: Automatic Debit, Card on File and the Patient Payment Plans Add-On Fee
content:
**How do automatic debit and a card on file affect the add-on fee on my Patient Payment Plans plan?**

The debit share of the add-on fee is 0.80 when the plan pays by automatic debit and your Patient Financial Account keeps a card on file; 0.90 when the plan pays by automatic debit and the account keeps no card on file; and 1 when the plan does not pay by automatic debit.

**How does the share act?** It multiplies the tier's setup fee within the scheduled add-on fee, acting on the tier's setup fee itself; the scheduled add-on fee is carried unrounded until the fee is entered.

**Which records decide it?** Whether automatic debit is enrolled on the plan, and whether the Patient Financial Account keeps a card on file.

| Plan pays by automatic debit | Card on file on the Patient Financial Account | Debit share |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 0.80 |
| Yes | No | 0.90 |
| No | Yes | 1 |
| No | No | 1 |

**Example (hypothetical tier setup fee of 40.00, this share alone).** A plan paying by automatic debit on an account with a card on file: 32.00. Without a card on file: 36.00. Without automatic debit: 40.00.
